user.title: Register a VkusVill application
user.description: Create a personal client on the [VkusVill registration page]({registration_url}). Choose “My service has no public URI” and verify that the registered address is `{redirect_uri}`. Enable purchase history and access renewal. Enter the credentials from VkusVill.

callback.title: Authorize VkusVill
callback.description: [Sign in to VkusVill]({authorize_url}) in the browser within five minutes. After consent, the browser returns to `{redirect_uri}` and may show a connection error. Paste the full address from the browser into this Home Assistant form and close the browser tab. Keep the address private.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect the VkusVill application
reauth_confirm.description: Verify purchase history and access renewal in the [VkusVill client settings]({registration_url}). This flow uses `{redirect_uri}`. If VkusVill replaced the client secret, enter the new one.

error.invalid_credentials: Check the OAuth client ID and secret from VkusVill.
error.invalid_callback: Paste the full callback address from this authorization attempt.
error.discovery_failed: Could not verify VkusVill's OAuth server. Check connectivity and try again.
error.rate_limited: VkusVill has requested a pause. Try again later.

abort.already_in_progress: An authorization attempt is already in progress.
abort.expired: The authorization attempt expired. Start setup or reauthentication again.
abort.invalid_scope: VkusVill did not grant the required purchase history or access renewal permission. Check your application settings.
abort.authorization_failed: VkusVill did not issue a usable grant. Check the registered callback, credentials and access renewal permission.
abort.connection_failed: VkusVill did not return usable OAuth or order history data. Try again from setup.
abort.provider_error: VkusVill could not finish authorization. Check the callback address and OAuth application settings.
abort.rate_limited: VkusVill has requested a pause. Try again later.
